svg.title: Root-way: Carved stone frieze
svg.desc: Root-way (2D): a long carved limestone frieze read left to right. The Glass Mountains stand as carved pillars; between them run vines carved like ropes, and on the city's breath they swell into bridges (a carved ripple in the upper register marks the breath, in and out). The keeper leads in low relief along a swollen vine with her staff braced, and the pilgrims follow in a file, the slowest last; a child walks at her father's side. One tower is still: its vine hangs straight and dry and the file must go the long way round inside it. A meander border along the foot carries a marker for how far the band has come.
